fns.desc: event_addr_failure() sets e->addr = NULL after deleting/freeing the failed address (:197) and, when other addresses remain, calls event_retry(e, 0). Inside event_retry(), do_next_address=0 means e->retry is NOT incremented, so if e->retry (unchanged) is already >= the now-shrunk dl_list_len(&s->addr_list), the 'giving up' branch dereferences e->addr->domain_and_port with e->addr == NULL -> NULL pointer dereference. Reachable e.g. with 2 addresses, e->retry==1, when the address at index 1 hits MAX_FAILURES and is deleted, leaving list len 1 == e->retry.
